support_claim: Commercial notes explicitly state Helion Industrial Systems Ltd is a different company from Helion Robotics Limited, which correspond to registry entries 11847299 and 11847201 respectively.

steps.fact: Candidate left referent registry:11847201 corresponds to company registry row 11847201 listing HELION ROBOTICS LIMITED.
Candidate right referent registry:11847299 corresponds to company registry row 11847299 listing HELION INDUSTRIAL SYSTEMS LTD.
Commercial notes identify Helion Robotics Limited as the legal entity used on invoices and Companies House, matching the same legal entity as the Helion Robotics operating name.
Commercial notes explicitly state that Helion Industrial Systems Ltd is a different company from Helion Robotics.
Registry row 11847299 names HELION INDUSTRIAL SYSTEMS LTD, the company referred to in the notes as Helion Industrial Systems Ltd.
Registry row 11847201 names HELION ROBOTICS LIMITED, the legal entity referred to in the notes as Helion Robotics Limited.
